title: Noroi no Yakata
summary:
This is a homemade game created using the game creation tool "Click & Create." It was released on the Japanese file-sharing site Vector in 1996 and was also featured in the computer magazine "TECH Win" at the time.

The creators are "Sankaku Onigiri & Tomo-chan." Apparently, it was co-created with the author's third-grade son.

The game was eventually deleted from Vector and seemingly forgotten, until 2008, when someone accidentally discovered the game's data and posted a gameplay video on Nico Nico Douga. The game's strange gameplay and music, as well as the protagonist's bizarre behavior upon death, became a huge hit among a small group of people, and at the author's request, it was re-released on Vector.

Sort through VHS tapes, stock up the shelves, and pick up after messy customers. Strive for perfection every day so Lily can be the best employee!

title: Phoenyx: Breaking the Cycle
summary: A visual novel focusing on the relationship of two girls researching a cabin with a mysterious mirror. Find out more about their past together, what they really mean to each other, and how it will unfold. Can you break their cycle?

title: Depths Unseen
summary: Fall into the ruins of the long abandoned Mariana Corp Lab that now sits vacant just below the surface. Can you survive this unforgiving world?

title: To Put Your Childhood Sweetheart Into A Refrigerator
The Overnight Screening
summary: The story unfolds through the eyes of a first-person protagonist. While working part-time at an old movie theater, the protagonist begins to experience strange and unexplainable events. You must survive the presence that lurks within the theater and uncover hidden clues to reach a meaningful ending.

title: Walk the Plank
summary: Walk the Plank is a next gen VR plank walking simulator set high up in New York City. Bring family and friends together for this intense intro to VR experience!

title: Flesh and Pressure
summary: Lovesick Girls Crave Pressure

title: Burning Out

title: Come to an End
summary: Race to the END in this horror labyrinth speed runner. Use abilities and survival instincts to get the END. Avoid traps and enemies while you are keeping an eye on the timer. Each level is unique with its own challenges and 3 different game modes. Are you up for the challenge?!

title: Ash Pines: The Motel
summary: Something is watching you, can you escape?

title: Crank It!
summary:
A cunning computer game where you find yourself in a cave surrounded by various pieces of patented technology.

You are not alone in the cave.

Meet your supervisor and try to make it through the shift.

title: Nothing Between Us...
summary: Waking up in an unknown, tiny room, 16 year old Flow is thrown into a bizarre situation unfitting his typical, uneventful life. With only the quirky and eternally-joyful Chinamu as his company, he must do his best to discover the meaning behind the vague instructions given to them and escape.

title: FNaF 3 Retro Edition
summary: This is a complete recreation of FNaF 3 in an 8-bit art style!

title: Mycopsychosys: Remastered
summary: Emergency Alert! New security protocols have been activated. Remain indoors. Do not open your doors under any circumstance. Isolation is safety. Isolation is truth. Or is it?

title: Hana's Light
summary: Hana's Light is a hidden-object game about loss and Tamagotchi.

title: Run from Bubol Horror
summary:
Something is wrong. Your thoughts are hazy, your memory shattered — but one thing is clear: you’re being hunted. The presence drawn to your fear.

You don’t know how it started. You don’t know what it wants. But it won’t stop.

It watches. It waits. And then… it strikes.

There’s no time to think — only time to run. Find a way to survive the impossible.
Every second counts. Every sound could be your last.

summary:
Chapter 2, Part Two is the fourth part of Your Turn to Die: Death Game By Majority. It was originally released on NicoNico on May 21, 2019.
On May 31st 2019, an English fan translation for it and all previous chapters would be released by VGpersons, which would later go on to be endorsed as official by Nankidai.

summary: Chapter 2, Part One is the third part of Your Turn to Die: Death Game By Majority. It was originally released on NicoNico on August 7, 2018.

title: Your Turn To Die: Chapter 1, Part Two
summary: Chapter 1, Part Two is the second part of Your Turn to Die: Death Game By Majority. It was originally released on NicoNico on January 31, 2018.

title: Your Turn To Die: Chapter 1, Part One
summary: Chapter 1, Part One is the first part of "Your Turn To Die: Death Game by Majority". It was originally released on NicoNico on August 28, 2017.

title: Don't Look Away 2

title: Roads Yet Traveled
summary:
"Do you think you can change the world? No matter who you are, you can only do so much, you have so little time to make a difference."

Like so many times before you are off to your first day of class. It's not an easy thing, first day jitters, but you manage. This is your life now, a cycle of moving and new beginnings. Always in flux, nothing staying the same. And today is no different.

In a flash everything is gone. With no clear way home, how will you manage? Will your new companions be able to keep you safe? Or will it all be too much?
Keep going though, you have nothing else to lose.

title: Stranded With Darkness
summary: From an Indie developer in Sweden we bring you Stranded With Darkness. A base building tower-defense like game, with up to 4 player online CO-OP. Stranded on a desert like planet, gather resources during the day, defend the SOS transmitter during the night. Survive as many days as possible.

title: Clowncore
summary: Your sister went missing in the woods. It's been years, but you never stopped searching. The only lead is the mysterious carnival she kept talking about.

title: Corner Shop: NightShift
summary: Take a night shift job in a place that runs on habit, not purpose. Restock shelves, take deliveries, clean the mess, and try to make it till morning. Not everything feels right and you’re never quite alone. Something waits in the dark.

title: A Box Full of Joy
summary: A grim and surreal adventure game.

title: The Automaton of Second London
summary:
A Victorian Fantasy Halloween Robo-Otome.

Arabella Harlow is a governess seeking new employment in the city of Second London one Halloween season. Her paths cross with an eccentric alchemist-inventor, who introduces her to his myriad of creations. One particular automaton is Jack, a humanoid construct with ruby-red eyes and intellect on par with a human's. But Jack cannot speak - not verbally. So Arabella is hired on to teach him how to communicate through alternate methods.

As they grow in their relationship - are they colleagues? are they comrades? are they confidantes? Arabella herself is not quite sure. - a series of tragic, dramatic events culminate in a murder. Secrets lurk in the city of Second London...secrets that may put Arabella's life in danger...

title: Milk Puzzle
summary:
even though you have all the pieces, you don't get the point

Contains
-neurotic protagonist
-constant failure of the bechdel test
-cunnilingus
-a complete lack of agency with the world around you
-but your life is like sooooo hard
-people just don't get it...

title: Secret HavEat
summary:
I am...

The world that the train has brought us to is a mysterious world.
This is a game in which a girl, HavEat, walks through a mysterious world.
What is the secret of HavEat that awaits her at the end of her walk?

title: My Little Foundation: Containment is Magic
summary: A mod for SCP Containment Breach that replaces SCP and setting with a darker version of My Little Pony : Friendship is Magic

title: The Fog Encounters
summary: There's a passenger who's gone mad from the fog, and a captain who's gravely injured inside the near-deserted airport. Counter the madman, follow the captains instructions and get your aircraft fueled to ESCAPE WITH YOUR LIFE.

title: Balloon Party
summary: The party room was supposed to be a joyful place, but is it really connected to “joy”? You need to interact with various objects in the party room and complete a series of explorations to find a glimmer of hope for escape. Can you... break free?

title: Yume Nikki Online Project

title: Delivery Pals
summary: Put on your thermos bags and head outside with your friends. You will have to deliver food to the aliens and make sure that the last company on Earth does not close down.

title: The Anomaly Protocol
summary: The Anomaly Protocol - Something is wrong with the building. Floors repeat, reality shifts, and you've been assigned to investigate. Use your checklist to track anomalies—but the deeper you go, the more the truth slips away.

title: Uncanny Tales: 1992
summary: Autumn, 1992. Anton, a 14-year-old boy, moves with his parents to a small town and is left alone in his grandmother's apartment. Meanwhile, children are disappearing across the town — the police are powerless, and no one knows who's behind it…

title: Yabai Otoko ni Nanpa Sareru Game
summary: Enjoy a conversation with a totally-not-suspicious handsome younger man.

title: The Town of Nie Iromusubi
summary: A strange tale, weaved like the petals of a flower.

Sonic.Exe 2: The Game

summary: Find supplies to maintain your stamina. Complete ten laps. Escape.

summary: Scary Bingo is a 52 card horror themed bingo game. Play with 8 people locally and avoid getting 4 across and be doomed. Also there's a memory minigame, just keep memorizing correctly and advance rounds and see how far you can go.

summary: Escape from a dying-typing game where the words you type become reality and turn against you.

title: Re:play
summary:
Ever wondered what you would do if you were given the chance to turn back time and relive your past? In this text-based interactive game, you wake up in a new body and unfamiliar environment, after having just died.

"Replay" starts at birth and ends at adulthood -- that is....if you survive up until that point. There are 9 possible endings. You'll meet many interesting people along the way. Who will be your friend...who will be your foe? You decide.

'What would you do if you were given a second chance at life?'

title: Anomaly Hunter: Observation Duty
summary: In Anomaly Hunter - Observation Duty, you're not just a security guard; you're the last line of defense against the unexplained. With only security cameras as your eyes, witness eerie movements and unsettling whispers echoing in the shadows.

title: The Haunting Of Stabbey Road
summary: Discover the dark secrets of a once renowned recording studio.

title: Haunted Property
summary: A new life begins in a low-cost apartment. Strange occurrences at night and the suspicious behavior of neighbors gradually push the protagonist to the edge.

title: The Last Tape
summary: A hidden truth. For over 50 years, Lurmont has been hiding incredibly dark secrets from the public. During an investigation, tapes are discovered showing all the atrocities they have committed.

title: Light Engine
summary: The light socket has suffered a leak!

title: [REC] Desolation
summary: [REC] Desolation takes you to an abandoned manor as journalist Ethan Carter. Your goal is to investigate its dark past and uncover the truth. But some secrets should remain hidden…

title: Magenta
summary:
...It seems the robot you created has grown too attached to you.

A story-focused game with dating elements.

title: House of Lost Souls
summary: A long-standing pain has driven Jack back to the old family home in search of answers. Discover the terrible truth this house held and how it relates to what happened to his parents in the distant past.

title: The Night of Escape

Players take on the role of an escapee, constantly dodging danger and utilizing clues found to survive and flee. The game adopts a first-person perspective, immersing you in the experience.

title: Knock on the Window
summary: Martin has been given an urgent assignment at work. However, for this he had to go to the house of his Boss. And so Martin found himself alone at home, in the middle of a vast field of sunflowers. Everything was going well until there was a knock on the window.

title: Death and Ladders
summary:
Death and Ladders: Roll the dice, climb the ladders, avoid scythes, take risky shortcuts, use Tarot Ability Cards to improve your odds or trap your opponent. Reach the end first to win.

You are supposed to die, but Death is bored to death doing the same job for an eternity. So he gave you a chance to win back your life, if you entertain him by playing his board game.

Gamble your soul in a relaxing atmosphere amongst a Skeleton crew, or if you want more of a challenge, try your luck against other unfortunate souls in Online or Local PVP.

title: Escape Observation
summary: ‘Escape Observation’ is a short walking simulator inspired by the game ‘The Exit 8’, where you can only move your character and control your vision. It is important to note that the game is not about finding out if a room has changed, but rather that each room is different and you must be aware of the signals that these changes give you.

title: Kollectomaniac
summary: A man offers you a job. Work at a log in the middle of the woods. Spend your money at the shop and improve your store. Don't stop collecting. Never miss collection day. Sell to the nine walkers. Stay away from the computer game.

title: Kusarihime: Jamais Vu
summary: Prequel to Kusarihime ~Euthanasia~, taking place a year before, introducing Itsuki with his memories in tact. It includes a trial version of the Kusarihime ~Euthanasia~, wallpapers, ringtones, and more.

title: Holo8
summary: Escape from the looping office. Observe the office carefully and look for any anomaly to reach the main entrance.

title: Super Mario: Blue Twilight
summary:
Super Mario: Blue Twilight is the lesser known first version of Super Mario: Blue Twilight DX. Released a year prior, this version is less polished, but carries most of the same ideas of its successor, also being a Halloween-themed Super Mario 2D platformer.

The game was lost up until 2025, when the creator, BlazeHedgehog, kindly uploaded it on the Internet Archive for preservation.

title: A Simple Garbage Sorting Game

title: The Paddy Field
summary: I was walking along the rice paddy path with my dog ​​Bonta. That was all I wanted to do. My ordinary daily life was suddenly shattered.

title: Innsmouth
summary: A ZX Spectrum text adventure game inspired by the novel "The Shadow over Innsmouth" written by H.P Lovecraft.

title: Slay the Alice
summary: A short visual novel presented with pixel art and cute animations. Chasing after a rabbit, Alice found herself in a land of talking plants. Now, it's time to go on a tiny little adventure.

title: Kamisama no Hitsugi
summary:
One day, a disaster occurs and the normal life of Chibana Michiru comes to an end.

He wakes up to a strange voice calling him, in front of him stands a classmate he has never spoken to before. He knows that they are inside the ”mysterious room”.

title: AliveZ
summary: Fifteen years ago, a mysterious shrine suddenly appeared. It emitted an evil air and people were transformed one after another.... Yin, a group of evil people, and Yang, a group of people who has an opposite nature to Yin. The story takes place in the midst of slaughter happened in the town....

title: Memory Girl +
summary: A tragic love story of Memory and her search for the missing "him." Fully conscious but trapped in the data of a game someone abandoned, Memory searches for "him."

title: Taking Over Her Heart
summary:
I have a crush on my best friend, Amelie.

I have a crush and I am so scared to ruin what we have.

...So scared that I'll probably never tell her that I love her.

Not unless someone helps me.

...Will you help me?

title: Since November
summary:
What are you doing with your time on Earth? Are you happy? Stay inside. We have pizza.

"Since November" is a short furry visual novel with about 12k words and four endings. It is written to be conclusive, so there will be no additional chapters. It is a game that was developed for the NovemBear 2024 Furry Visual Novel Jam.

title: A Gracewind Tale: Midnight Shift with Lenny Motts
summary: It's a cold December night in Gracewind. You're about to close shop at the Gracewind Video, when a man named Lenny Motts appears on all the television screens. He has decided to play a little game with you, will you play or not?

title: Liminal Shift
summary: A unique atmospheric suspense game developed using the latest Unreal Engine 5 technologies such as Lumen and Nanite. With every step you take, Liminal Shift pushes you deeper into an eerie, unsettling experience like no other.

title: Mr. Lupin
summary: On a wonderful winter night, the moonlight bathes the silent streets, your own footsteps echoing softly. But wait... did you just hear someone whispering your name?

In this game, you have to run, dash, jump, and slide to avoid traps and stay alive. While running, you need to collect pages to move on to the next level.

title: The 4th Wall
summary: What lies beyond The 4th Wall?

title: Parasocial! Paranoia! Paradise!
summary: You just got yourself a new girlfriend! She's everything you could have ever wanted! Now just be sure she doesn't escape.

title: Boku to Iu Mono
summary: The protagonist character has 'lived' alone and unfeeling as a conscience inhabiting random objects and animals for random times for as long as he can remember — but one day, he turns into the shape of a human boy. His life changes utterly when the human girl Sae decides to try to befriend him, naming him "Ao" for his deep blue eyes as he cannot speak. Every day, they have fun playing hide and seek — but one day, Sae stops coming...

title: Mr. Wolf
summary: Little red riding hood and wolf are rival

summary:
Your roommate went missing several months ago.

You finally gain a conscience and go look for her.

You find a strange girl in the woods.

The distressed voice on the other end speaks of Lost Apartment, a place steeped in sinister legends.

This is a fan visual novel adaptation of the original.

title: Monoyellow Madness
summary: Backrooms game with procedurally generated rooms and corridors.

title: Slender: New Hope
summary: Slender - New Hope is based on Slender: The Eight Pages, but with modern graphic, better AI, bigger environment & discoverable deep woods!

title: Chica's Party World: Rebaked
summary: Chica's Party World: REBAKED is the official reboot / re-imagining of the original game from 2018 by PoisonousPastels and BonBun_Studios. The game sees you playing as a security robot designated with the task of watching over the building and running basic maintenance tasks until proper renovations begin. However (obviously) things aren't quite what they seem at first.

title: Under Your Moon

You're entirely alone-- until you're not. Entirely out of place, entirely by surprise, a mysterious person appears in your apartment. The first person that you've seen in years-- and then they're gone again, just as quickly. It's undeniable that something is changing, and that is has to with this stranger--
And something tells you that you'll see them again.

title: TransMemory
summary: I woke up in a dimly lit basement. You have no memory of who you are or why you are here. Can you escape from this place?

title: Unicycle Pizza Time!

summary:
This is an interactive-essay-meets-walking-sim about technocapitalism and the things we lost along the way.
Follow coins under the electric mist of a clouded starry sky. Discover hyper-links. Listen to the words both inside and outside your head. Seal your fate before the productivity machine. Together we can defeat the machine.

summary:
There's a tunnel that is rumored to allow you to meet a dead person if you pass through it at 2am.
After hearing this, Kyoka, decides to go to the tunnel with his boyfriend Yukio, but...

A short BL visual novel.

“Someday — Someday, until this happy dream gets shattered.”

Two short stories. A sequel to Saikoro Saiko that reveals what happens to Metarou and Saiko. And a prequel to Saikoro Saiko that shows us the story about a promise between two girls, Nana and Saiko.

title: Saikoro Saiko: Memento Mori

“Death is salvation. I'm sure she would want it too.”

Behind the scenes of Saikoro Saiko, the story of Saiko.
The fearsome yandere who knows everything, and what happened to her.

“Evening tea carries the scent of death.”

A girl calling herself your girlfriend appears in front of you, who has no memory.
Although you're meant to have a good relationship with her, gradually her true nature is revealed...?! Uncover her true motives!!

“Well then, here and now, let's talk about the truth that was never revealed.”

Empty words, secret words and finally, "my own words". Everything about the mysterious boy "Akino" is revealed here.

You must not set foot in this story with a pure and loving heart.
When you pursue the forbidden secret of the girl, you will be struck down to the depths of hell...

I don't want my girlfriend to break up with me.....
But I want to cheat on her......
Then, I just have to 'cheat' without getting caught!!

title: Aether Diving

"The Aether Diving program aims to perceive energy levels in the body and help get rid of imperfections. These imperfections get in the way of a healthy lifestyle. Pairing the latest in technology and relentless study of the Divine Scriptures, we have kept our followers’ faults and defects at bay. Join us now, diving deep into consciousness and freeing the mind from torment. Enlightment awaits."
-High Priest Maxime

"SLENDER THE EIGHT PAGES" Demake only for the Gameboy Color.

Will you comply or defy?

2Ship2Harkinian is a mod of the famous Nintendo 64 game,

Meet Rosetta Halloway, a kind and hardworking young adult with a curious streak and a love of gardening.

In her backyard is a stone waterwell filled to the brim with black water.

The fact that this well didn't previously exist there is one thing, but then strange noises start coming from within it, which prompts Rosetta to investigate.

Out comes a mysterious mermaid, Galatea of the Well, who appears to be particularly interested in getting acquainted with her.

So, what exactly is this piscine stranger's deal? Do you have the strength to find out?

"I'm Gary Walker, just an average 27-year-old office worker. Always hunting for cheaper places to live.
